responsibility: This header centralizes SPARC option-related enumerations shared by generated option code and the backend. It defines the processor identifiers used by -mcpu/-mtune and the cpu attribute, the SPARC-V9 code model enum used by -mcmodel, and the memory model enum used by -mmemory-model, providing the stable symbolic types that tie sparc.opt, sparc.md, and sparc.cc together.
